methodology.missing_values: null means not measured; never substituted with zero
methodology.replay_usage: logical source tokens may be retained; replay incurs zero new provider calls
methodology.cost: estimate only from supplied rates; actual vendor bill remains unknown
methodology.failed_calls: failed tasks, empty responses and diagnostic runs still count whenever provider usage exists; completion_tokens already includes reasoning tokens
methodology.small_samples: n=1 is a single observation, not evidence of statistical significance
methodology.budget_confound: if worker count also changes admission CPU budget, serial/parallel results are their joint effect, not a pure parallelism intervention
methodology.provider_confound: remote latency, vendor prefix cache warming, request order and nondeterministic model outputs may affect time/cost independently of the local scheduler and JSON cache
methodology.scope: one controlled project fixture cannot establish benefits for arbitrary real repositories
methodology.wait_metric: per-run mean/max of dependency-ready task wait values; excludes unmet-dependency time
methodology.peak_memory: must be measured simultaneously for the workflow, not summed task peaks
methodology.redaction: allowlisted metadata/counts only; prompts, answers, keys, stdout and extra fields excluded
